evidence.title: Google turns its Antigravity coding agent into a free Gemini API tool - Startup Fortune

name: Google turns its Antigravity coding agent into a free Gemini API tool
summary: News article on Google folding the Antigravity coding agent into the Gemini API as a managed, sandboxed agent.
description: A Startup Fortune news article reporting that Antigravity, until recently a standalone IDE, is now a managed agent inside the Gemini API and Google AI Studio through the Interactions API. The agent runs on Gemini 3.8 Flash in a Google-hosted Linux sandbox with code execution, search and file handling, free during preview; the article covers token costs, introductory Gemini 3.8 Flash pricing and the comparison with OpenAI's AgentKit and Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.
contains: Antigravity is now a managed agent in the Gemini API and Google AI Studio
runs on Gemini 3.8 Flash in a hosted Linux sandbox, free during preview
sandbox compute not billed during preview; token costs still apply
Gemini 3.8 Flash introductory pricing of $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens through 2026
positions against OpenAI AgentKit and Anthropic Claude Agent SDK
